newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - BULLS TO DRIVE BUNDS TO 102.25.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - BULLS TO DRIVE BUNDS TO 102.25.

text.p: September Bund futures will try to push up towards resistance around 102.25 on Thursday, after the contract managed to cling above support around 101.50 on Wednesday, technical analysts said.
"Overall, on a longer term time frame, we consider this to be a bull market still," said Bob Emanuels, vice-president at ABN-AMRO Hoare Govett in Amsterdam.

"The medium term trend support at 101.50 and the longer term support at 101.00 haven't broken." Emanuels said, adding his first target was 102.25,26 -- a 38 percent retracement of the move from 103.52 on July 23 to 101.50 on August 6.
